challenge.method: Compared the Appendix D heading, date, and §0 with the same-release GPLv2 and GPLv3 edition headings. Used GPLv3 §14 and the version-3-or-later declarations in iostream and libcc1.cc to test whether a program's version election could alter the identity finding.
challenge.results: GPLv2 identifies a different edition dated June 1991. GPLv3 §14 makes version choices depend on the Program's declaration, including an express later-version option, an unnumbered declaration, or a designated proxy where applicable. Both file notices expressly offer version 3 or later. These controls disclose no material contradiction in the Appendix D edition identity.
